title: Excel for Finance
shortDescription: Work faster and more reliably in Excel: functions, financial formulas, data tools and clean model design.
description: A hands-on course that takes you from basic spreadsheet use to confident, finance-grade Excel. You will learn the functions analysts use every day, build time value of money and loan schedules, analyse data with lookups, pivots and charts, and structure workbooks that are easy to audit.
whoFor: Students and graduates preparing for finance internships or jobs
CFA®/FRM® candidates who want to check calculations in Excel
Working professionals who want to stop fighting their spreadsheets
outcomes: Navigate and format workbooks quickly using keyboard shortcuts
Use lookup, logical, text, date and statistical functions fluently
Build loan schedules, NPV/IRR analyses and return calculations
Summarise data with tables, pivot tables and charts
Design clean, auditable workbooks and stress test them with data tables

faq.q: Which Excel version do I need?
faq.a: Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 is ideal. Most lessons also work in Excel 2016/2019; dynamic-array lessons note when a newer version is required.

faq.q: Do I need any finance background?
faq.a: No. Finance concepts are explained as they appear.
